assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: dedicated production-candidate enemy animation atlas for a native Godot pixel RPG, NOT a concept comparison sheet.
Draw ONE original moonstone observatory sentinel in four distinct animation poses in a precise 2 by 2 grid. Tall portrait 1280x1600 canvas, each quadrant fully separate with wide transparent cross gutters and generous margins. Full bodies contained entirely in their own cells, same camera, same body/head/limb sizes and boot baseline.
Enemy design: squat heavy stone-and-brass automaton, about 3.5 heads high, ivory moonstone armor with dark violet recesses, cyan celestial core in its chest, crescent crest, blue eye slit, engraved sparse gold runes, TWO thick articulated arms and TWO planted block feet. No human face, no fabric cape, no handheld weapon. Face and body three-quarter toward LEFT to oppose a mage standing left of screen. Original detailed 16-bit fantasy / tactical RPG pixel sprite craft, crisp grouped clusters, hard stepped edges, controlled highlights, stone/metal material contrast, readable broad silhouette. Do not use smooth illustration, tiny noise, anti-aliased haze.
Frame0 TOP LEFT: idle guarded stance, cyan core calm.
Frame1 TOP RIGHT: anticipation, both forearms raised toward chest core, knees slightly lowered, core brighter but NO effect cloud.
Frame2 BOTTOM LEFT: actual attack, one articulated forearm thrust LEFT, other arm braces torso, core open. Both hands visible, whole forearm fully inside own cell. Energy projectile will be drawn by game code, do NOT paint it here.
Frame3 BOTTOM RIGHT: stagger after receiving a spell, torso recoils to RIGHT and both arms spread slightly; feet remain planted and same scale.
Opaque subject pixels on genuinely transparent alpha, no background, floor, cast shadow, particles, caption, labels, panel borders or text. Do not clip crest, hands or feet.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE dedicated eight-tile INVENTORY ICON ATLAS for a native 16-bit fantasy mage RPG. This is a UI texture atlas, not concept alternatives.
Exact regular 4 columns by 2 rows, wide landscape 1536x768 canvas, eight equal square cells. One isolated icon centered within each cell, every icon stays in central 65% of its cell, huge transparent gutters, no overlap or border crossing. Same pixel density, same top-left light, crisp grouped pixel clusters and limited color ramps, bright readable silhouettes at small size, dark violet outline, clear metal/crystal/paper materials. Genuine alpha transparency outside, opaque icons. No text, numbers, labels, panel/card backgrounds, floor shadows, glows outside silhouette, checkerboard or frame.
TOP ROW left to right:
0. spark: a lilac vellum spell scroll, rolled corners, dark purple star-shaped seal, one pale four-point star rune; vertical scroll silhouette.
1. fire_mote: a faceted orange-red ember crystal with a contained small flame-shaped tip, gold/amber core.
2. water_mote: a sapphire-blue water-drop crystal with pale cyan inner highlight, round tear silhouette.
3. wind_mote: a pale jade feather-shaped crystal with two curling mint air ribbons tightly contained in its silhouette.
BOTTOM ROW left to right:
4. flame_glyph: a square violet-gold runic tablet with one bold orange fire sigil in center, NOT a scroll.
5. tide_lances: THREE distinct narrow cyan crystal lances arranged in a fan, silver base, long needle silhouettes, no more than three.
6. arcane_focus: a large faceted amethyst core seated in a small antique brass socket with two side prongs; symmetric support focus.
7. mage_ward: a horizontal indigo enamel talisman plate with silver edge and a single crescent-shield emblem, clearly different from orange fire tablet.
Original detailed tactical RPG pixel item icons. Not painted smooth illustrations or a collage. Preserve wide empty spacing and exactly eight icons.
